afdrukken.nadruk: This is a waterfall coming over a mossy cliff. Put a full, saturated moss green into the cliff face and the banks - green is the colour that carries this print. The sky at the top left is bare paper.

The three sheep are the subject and they must read first. Cut them dark and closed in the key ink so they stand clear against the paper. The hillside behind them is bare paper: no hatching, no rows of dashes, at most a single thin ridge line where it meets the sky. Put a full grass green into the tussocks they are standing in.
The church with its red roof is the subject. The sky is bare paper - no rows of dashes around the tower. The green slope and the red roof carry the colour.
A wide waterfall in a canyon. Put a full, saturated moss green into the banks and the canyon rim. The water keeps its rows of broken dashes.
A wrecked aeroplane on black sand. Push the warm ink further than usual: a real orange in the stripe along the fuselage and in the ground it lies on.

The black timber church is the whole subject and nothing may compete with it. The sky is bare paper - no rows of dashes anywhere above the horizon. Keep the stone wall thin and the mountains behind it to a single thin contour line. The grass in front carries the green.

A wing seen from inside the aeroplane, with the coast far below. No dashes in the sky at all - the sky is bare paper. The sea below the wing does keep its rows of short broken dashes; that contrast between empty sky and dashed water is the point of this print.
